title: IVG  Air 2-in-1 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit
description: The IVG Air 2-in-1 Prefilled Pod kit is perfect for vapers who enjoy a variety of flavours. This innovative device combines the convenience of a rechargeable system with IVG’s premium flavours contained in prefilled pods. Equipped with a reliable 850mAh battery, the IVG Air 2-in-1 ensures prolonged use and consistent performance, making it ideal for all-day vaping. The device features a USB Type-C charging port for rapid recharging, ensuring you’re never left without your vape for long. The IVG Air 2in1 devise includes two prefilled IVG Air pods, each containing 2ml of 20mg (2%) nic salt e-liquid. These pods offer a premium mouth-to-lung (MTL) experience that’s gentle on the throat while relieving nicotine cravings fast. With this edition, you can enjoy a duo of delectable flavours: The IVG Air 2 in 1 has a selection of 6 editions that come in a variety of flavours: Cream Edition - Lemon & Lime and Pinepple Ice Pink Edition - Fizzy Cherry and Strawberry Ice Blue Edition - Blue Sour Raspberry and Blue Raspberry Ice Black Edition - Pineapple Ice and Fizzy Cherry Purple Edition - Lemon Cherry Passionfruit and Lemon & Lime Gold Edition - Blue Raspberry Ice and Fizzy Cherry Instructions: The IVG Air 2-4-1 vaping system is designed for ease of use, providing a ready-to-vape experience right out of the box. Follow these five simple steps to start enjoying your vape: 1. Remove all packaging from the device, including the bottom sticker and the mouthpiece rubber. 2. Simply press the button on the side of the device to open the lid. 3. After the mouthpiece is hinged aside, insert the two IVG Air prefilled pods with the arrows facing down into the device. 4. To close the device, simply close and press the mouthpiece until you hear the click. 5. To select your desired flavour, lift up and rotate the mouthpiece to switch between flavours. Please Note: A USB-C Cable is not included. Shop IVG Air Refill Pods
